# HMS 故障码 / HMS codes · 03

[返回索引 / Index](../../HMS-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `HMS 0300-B800-0001-0001` | 工具头电源异常，可能是TH板损坏或USB-C线短路。 | Toolhead power abnormality detected; it may be caused by a damaged TH board or a short circuit in the USB-C cable. |
| `HMS 0300-B800-0001-0002` | 工具头通信丢失且电流异常，已自动切断工具头电源。请重启设备；若问题反复出现，请联系售后支持。 | Toolhead communication lost and abnormal current detected. The toolhead power has been cut off. Please restart the device. If the issue persists, contact customer support. |

| `HMS 0300-C100-0001-0002` | 风道无法进入腔温保持模式，请检查风门状态。 | Airflow System failed to activate heating mode; please check the air door status. |

| `HMS 0300-C200-0001-0002` | 过滤切换风门霍尔传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动。 | Hall sensor of Filter Switch Flap malfunction: please check if the wiring is loose. |

| `HMS 0300-C300-0001-0002` | 过滤切换风门电流传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动或硬件采样电路故障。 | Current sensor of Filter Switch Flap malfunction: this may be due to an open circuit or a hardware sampling circuit fault. |
| `HMS 0300-C300-0001-0003` | 顶部自动风门电流传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动或硬件采样电路故障。 | Current sensor of Automatic Top Vent malfunction: this may be due to open circuit or a hardware sampling circuit fault. |

| `HMS 0300-D000-0001-0002` | 刀切刀架掉落，请重新安装。 | The blade holder has fallen off; please reinstall it. |
| `HMS 0300-D000-0001-0003` | 刀切模组连接线脱落，请检查。 | The cutting module cable has come loose; please check the cable connection. |
| `HMS 0300-D100-0001-0001` | 灭火器电机断路，可能是电机连接器没插紧或电机故障，请扫码查看Wiki处理。 | Fire extinguisher motor has an open-circuit. There may be a loose connection, or the motor may have failed. Scan the QR code for details. |
| `HMS 0300-D100-0001-0002` | 灭火器电机异常，请断开灭火器电源后重新插上电源线。 | Fire extinguisher motor error. Please power off and then power on to restart the extinguisher. |
| `HMS 0300-D300-0002-0001` | 灭火器未连接，请确认灭火器电源线连接正常，且4pin信号线连接牢固。 | Fire extinguisher not detected. Please ensure the signal cable is securely connected and the plug is fully inserted. |
| `HMS 0300-D400-0001-0002` | 灭火器在位检测传感器异常，请检查传感器连接线是否松动或损坏。 | The fire extinguisher presence detection sensor is malfunctioning. Please check if the sensor cable is loose or damaged. |
| `HMS 0300-D500-0002-0004` | 灭火器气瓶未安装，请前往自动灭火界面确认。 | Fire extinguisher cylinder not installed. Please confirm on the extinguisher page. |
| `HMS 0300-D500-0002-0005` | 灭火器气瓶已耗尽，请及时更换气瓶。若已更换气瓶，请在自动灭火界面进行确认。 | The Fire Extinguisher Gas Cylinder is empty. Please replace the gas cylinder and then confirm the replacement on the Auto Fire Extinguishing System page. |
| `HMS 0300-D600-0001-0006` | 灭火器电机复位失败，请断开灭火器电源后重新插上。 | Fire extinguisher motor reset failed. Please power off and then power on to restart the extinguisher. |
| `HMS 0300-D600-0001-0007` | 灭火器电机复位卡滞，请小幅度左右拧动应急手轮直至阻力变小，断开灭火器电源后重新插上电源线。 | The fire extinguisher motor reset is jammed. Please gently turn the emergency handwheel left and right until the resistance decreases. Then, power off the fire extinguisher and turn it back on. |
| `HMS 0300-D700-0001-0003` | 检测到激光旋转轴上的加工物体与工具头发生碰撞，请更换合适尺寸的加工物体后重试，支持的加工物体尺寸范围详见 Wiki。 | The workpiece on the rotary attachment collided with the toolhead. Please replace it with a properly sized workpiece and try again. See the Wiki for supported size ranges. |
| `HMS 0300-D700-0002-0001` | 检测到激光旋转轴附件未连接，请确认附件已正确安装并插好连接线。 | The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in. |
| `HMS 0300-D700-0002-0002` | 检测到已安装旋转轴附件，请将其取下后继续操作。 | The rotary attachment is detected. Please remove it before continuing. |
| `HMS 0300-D800-0001-0001` | 检测到激光旋转轴的电机断路，可能是电机连接器没插紧或电机故障。 | The rotary attachment motor has an open-circuit. There may be a loose connection, or the motor may have failed. |
| `HMS 0300-D800-0001-0002` | 检测到激光旋转轴的电机异常，请断开激光旋转轴电源后重新上电。 | The rotary attachment motor error. Please power off and then power on to restart the rotary attachment. |
| `HMS 0300-D900-0002-0001` | 检测到激光旋转轴的电机与位置传感器通信异常。如重启设备无法解决问题，请联系售后服务。 | Communication error between the rotary attachment motor and the position sensor. If restarting fails, please contact customer support. |
| `HMS 0300-DA00-0002-0001` | 检测到激光模组，请取下热端挂架上的热端，以防激光加工碎屑影响热端打印功能。 | Laser module detected. Please remove the hotend from the hotend rack to prevent laser processing debris from affecting printing performance. |
| `HMS 0300-DB00-0002-0001` | 已检测到激光模组，请正确安装右喷嘴，以确保后续激光模组挂载校准正常。 | Laser module detected. Please install the right nozzle correctly to ensure proper Laser Module Mounting Calibration. |
| `HMS 0300-E000-0001-0001` | 热端挂架电机未连接或存在开路异常，请检查电机软排线连接是否正常。 | Hotend holder motor is disconnected or has an open-circuit fault. Please check the motor’s flat cable connection. |
| `HMS 0300-E000-0001-0002` | 热端挂架电机相间短路异常。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。 | Inter-phase short circuit on hotend holder motor. If restarting doesn’t resolve the issue, please contact support. |
| `HMS 0300-E000-0001-0003` | 热端挂架电机三相电阻异常或不平衡。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。 | Hotend holder motor has abnormal or unbalanced three-phase resistance. If restarting doesn’t help, please contact support. |
| `HMS 0300-E000-0001-0004` | 热端挂架电机堵转，请检查是否有异物卡住，或是否与工具头发生碰撞。 | Hotend holder motor is stalled. Please check for foreign objects or collisions with the toolhead. |
| `HMS 0300-E100-0001-0001` | 热端挂架电机电流传感器异常，可能是采样电路故障。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。 | Current sensor fault on hotend holder motor. This may be caused by a sampling circuit failure. If restarting the printer doesn’t resolve the issue, please contact customer support. |
| `HMS 0300-E200-0002-0001` | 热端挂架电机与位置传感器通信异常。如重启打印机无法解决问题，建议联系售后服务。 | Communication error between the hotend holder motor and the position sensor. If restarting fails, please contact customer support. |
| `HMS 0300-E300-0001-0001` | 热端挂架电机驱动板MOS管短路异常，如果重启打印机无法解决问题，建议联系售后服务。 | The MOS tubes of the Hotend Holder motor drive board are short-circuited. If restarting the printer does not resolve the problem, please contact customer support. |
| `HMS 0300-E300-0001-0002` | MC与挂架控制板通信异常，请检查连接线是否连接牢靠。 | MC communication with Rack Control Board failed. Please check if the connection cable is properly plugged in. |
| `HMS 0300-E500-0002-0001` | 检测到多次运动丢步，请先检查工具头是否存在异物阻挡或异响。可继续执行并观察状态，若出现明显错层，请参考Wiki进行维护。 | Multiple motion step losses are detected. Please first check if there is any foreign object obstruction or abnormal noise on the tool head. You may continue and observe the quality. If obvious layer misalignment occurs, refer to the Wiki for maintenance. |
